subject.title: fix(streaming): preserve paragraph separators across block-streamed deliveries [AI-assisted]

question: Should the permanent block-streaming contract preserve paragraph boundaries with explicit seam metadata or another complete in-budget mechanism before merge, or may this PR land as a known partial text-only repair?
rationale: The source-proven bug is real, but the remaining exact-boundary case cannot be resolved by the current in-band text shape without a maintainer decision on delivery semantics and sibling PR consolidation.

options.title: Require a complete shared fix
options.body: Require the landing branch to preserve blank-line reconstruction for exact and near-maxChars splits without over-limit chunks, then merge one consolidated candidate.

options.title: Adopt explicit boundary metadata
options.body: Ask the contributor or replacement branch to carry paragraph/newline/hard-split seam metadata through chunker, subscriber, and coalescer.

options.title: Accept a partial common-case repair
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally land the common-case improvement while leaving the near-limit boundary documented as remaining work on the canonical issue.

recommendation.title: Require a complete shared fix
recommendation.body: Require the landing branch to preserve blank-line reconstruction for exact and near-maxChars splits without over-limit chunks, then merge one consolidated candidate.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest recent history across block coalescing, chunking hardening, and current-file layout near the affected contract.
